id./param/scenario/cs/a_110_cs_030.pack|cs_: "The grave of this country's king and queen, of Dundrasil.
"Indeed. The Luminary {var:1}'s true parents. That is, my daughter and her husband, who died sixteen years ago.
"My daughter died, her husband died... yet I survived, so it must mean something. I had to believe that; it was too painful.
"So for sixteen years I searched. Why did Dundrasil fall? Finding the cause became my purpose in life.
"Traveling about, I learned of the change of heart in my ally, King Carnelian, a believer in the Luminary legend...
"From that day, King Carnelian changed utterly and began denouncing the Luminary as the Darkspawn.
"He even blamed his own daughter's death on the Luminary. I could not believe the king was in his right mind.
"Something is amiss behind the scenes. I swore to solve both mysteries: my fallen country and my ally's change of heart.
"Eleanor, Irwin... Rejoice. Your son is here. He is alive and well...
"Welcome back, my grandson. Thank you for... for surviving.
"After sixteen years, I could meet my beloved grandson again. Will you grant this grandfather a request?
"The house of Dundrasil has a requiem ritual passed down for generations. Let us mourn Eleanor and the others together.
"The ritual is held at the altar on the hill behind the castle. Come with me to the altar.
